findings: Kolyma Plus published an on-site report on July 6, 2026, with a direct interview attributed to the Data Center Magadan general director. Its complete article describes foundations and engineering infrastructure currently being built. This is a strong in-window physical-work lead, not merely financing or a permit; the exact interview or visit date is not separately specified.

The July 9 Magspace article attributes a related governor visit to the regional government and links Magadan Pravda as its source. The linked page returned HTTP403 to an ordinary credential-free request; no retry or access-control workaround was attempted, and no denied body is selected as evidence. The original government publication was not located in the bounded search.

The operator facility page matches Magadan/Orutukan and the advertised nine-building project but supplies only a settlement-level project address. Its separate Magadan legal-office address is excluded. Its construction gallery is labeled August 2026 without a day; this interval crosses August 20 and is not normalized into an in-window observation.

Search discovery returned a sanitary-zone record titled for the 150MW mining data center on parcel 49:08:040115:203. This third-party registry mirror is not independently captured or promoted to authoritative cadastral identity. The listed 1764294-square-metre sanitary zone is not the approximately 20-hectare campus. Its MSK-49 zone2 coordinate table cannot be used as a campus boundary or transformed with an assumed CRS definition.

A September 12, 2025 municipal-newspaper PDF search result mentions the same parcel in a zoning change. The PDF was not fetched or reviewed and is a next-step discovery only, not accepted source evidence or proof of current construction.

The offsite Orutukan 220kV substation reconstruction, a separate proposed step-down substation, corporate office and settlement center are not acceptable substitute campus geometries. No coordinate, polygon, spatial duplicate-screen result, normalized capacity, role, workload or imagery outcome is selected.

No matching Magadan, Orutukan or MiningSpace name was found in the current 173-site cohort or the scoped prior research/curated/v97 identity search. This is a bounded textual alias screen only, not proof of distinctness. Exact geometry and full-cohort geometry comparison remain required.
